HGT candidates (AU tests)

Places where the flagellar genes group genomes against GTDB. Primary = passes the shortlist rule (in ≥ 10 gene trees and the concatenated tree; one-sided; GTDB branch not unusually short); exploratory = fails one criterion, tested for a stated reason. AU test: does the flagellar alignment reject the GTDB arrangement? p < 0.05 = yes. Candidates were chosen from the same trees, so p-values are post-selection.
